name: focused-capture-dimensions
goal: Show stored focused image dimensions instead of invented desktop defaults.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: A real retained desktop image was 1280 pixels wide, while focusedScenario replaced its known dimensions with the conventional 1440 by 900 label.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing overview fixture had no recorded nonstandard dimensions. Extend that standard case to require 1280 by 720 and reject the invented desktop label.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Record fa9f9bca0baf45d6aac72fa2b178e77782f717e606aad68bee300275ef9f2c31 at 782daf5f fails the named dimension assertion. Shared preview readiness is preserved; all 50 Explorer browser cases pass.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Preserved the known captured dimensions before conventional viewport defaults. Current source matches df2507ff exactly; red bb249e74 restores only the original one-line precedence bug, with the final unchanged test corpus.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Record 626049966c5026214fdd266b5883daa706d1be9354885e54880b31ace675c0d2 passes the same 22 tests at d4349505e4083bbc09d2ca0c3f910f0d935bd81d.
